# start-from-here

> start-from-here is a free, MIT-licensed, open Agent Skill (agentskills.io open standard) for AI coding agents. It interviews you with recommended defaults, recommends a stack, gets your brief approval, then generates a complete pre-development document set (PRD, architecture, database, API, security, testing, legal, AGENTS.md) before any code is written. It never writes application code.

Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor and more, plus chat apps. Install: `npx skills add ilramdhan/start-from-here` or `npx start-from-here@latest install` (Node.js >= 18).
